Reason for Mistake: The FileSurfer agent repeatedly failed to execute its assigned instructions to read the specific log files requested by the Planner. Instead of reading the contents of the JSON files (e.g., `20250715_171814_0001_analyze_and_determine_error_type.json`) to extract the exact error messages, stack traces, and raw data, the agent simply outputted the content of the summary file (`20250715_171814_summary.json`) it had already read in Step 2. This loop of reading the same summary file occurred multiple times (Steps 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14) without ever progressing to read the detailed execution logs necessary to diagnose the specific "Error in content generation." The agent ignored the explicit instruction to "Retrieve contents of the following files" and instead provided redundant information, preventing the diagnosis from moving forward.
